reviews.title: An app that forgets you already paid for it
reviews.text:
Never as good as the old version but generally ok. The app seems to be on the downhill slide now though. It's doing the "move things behind the subscription paywall" part of the spiral. 
They seem to forget many of us already paid for the app and have no interest in cloud services or subscriptions.

reviews.title: Retrograde Step
reviews.text: The old version was much easier to navigate and make changes. Sorry this newer version is not a step forward in my humble opinion.

reviews.title: Premium???
reviews.text: Why don’t you tell us what the annoying pop-up everyday is for it pops up frequently despite the vendor saying it displays only once - trollope. Stop the ‘premium’ advert to entice more cost each time I load the app. You don’t even state what you get with your ‘premium’ after I’ve already paid for it. Avoid this software until this is fixed. The ‘premium’ pop-up is really annoying and it doesn’t only show up if you reset the app. It displays every time I want to use the app. Please make it stop I’m not interested.
